answer: We prove Sybil resistance by showing that a personalized EigenTrust walk cannot easily cross a sparse cut to harbor malicious weight. Under this spectral barrier, transition probability out of the Sybil nebula decays exponentially, isolating adversarial nodes. To enforce a robust Nash equilibrium, validators deploy staking collateral bound to slashing penalties verified via zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions. This paradigm secures consensus with the precision of a quartz clock, ensuring a strictly negative expected utility for any attack.
